title: Sloppy American-Style Chicken Casserole
description: A delicious casserole with a gooey, meaty twist, inspired by Indian flavors. This dish is perfect for a comforting meal.
instructions: Cook the basmati rice according to package instructions.
In a large skillet, heat 2 tablespoons of oil over medium-high heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until translucent, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Add the ground beef and cook until browned, breaking it up with a spoon as it cooks.
Add the curry powder and cumin powder, and cook for 1 minute.
Stir in the tomato puree and chicken broth, and bring the mixture to a simmer.
Reduce the heat to low and let it cook while you prepare the chicken.
Season the chicken breast with salt and pepper, and cook in a separate skillet over medium-high heat until browned and cooked through.
Shred the cooked chicken with two forks and add it to the skillet with the meat mixture.
Stir in the cooked rice and shredded mozzarella cheese.
Transfer the mixture to a 9x13 inch baking dish and top with additional shredded cheese.
Bake in the preheated oven for 20-25 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
